author: Rizza_Razor
quote:
“GTA 6 isn’t a perfect game” 
Minus 3 points for max 30 fps and no choice of lower graphics and better performance mode in 2026 is actual insanity.
Minus 2 points for no multiplayer on release again it’s 2026!, I’m fully aware that they do this with every game and I am annoyed it’s not out on release with every game.
Minus .5 points for Jason’s incredible monotone and terrible voice acting that drove me insane within 5 minutes.
Minus .5 points for all the repetitive monotonous boring stuff they decided to add, make sure you fix the house, rearrange furniture, stop in at the petrol station and get petrol, if you want to make sure the cops leave you alone make sure to change outfits and change vehicles every single time.
The only positive I can even say about this game is that scrolling on social media whilst driving is actually hilarious and the most fun I’ve had playing the game
